title: Persist experiment lifecycle and give failed legs an exit (VC-201-011)
goal: VC-201-011 refuted: ExperimentLog is in-memory only — a restart forgets all experiments and applied_transitions, so 'durable transitions' and kill-and-resume are untestable; Isolated -> Rejected is impossible so a failed isolation wedges an experiment forever; propose() on an existing id silently resets state while applied_transitions survives, making it unrecoverable; nothing outside tests calls ExperimentLog. Evidence: crates/susi-gawd/src/tests/vc_201_011_mastery.rs.
